scenario.summary: Threat actors use the Knight Office phishing kit to perform Adversary-in-the-Middle (AiTM) attacks against Microsoft 365 accounts via the Device Code flow. After harvesting session tokens using residential callback proxies and redirect infrastructure, the attackers establish persistence by enrolling rogue devices in Microsoft Entra ID and binding Windows Hello for Business (WHfB) keys to the compromised accounts.

meta.rationale: The hunt scopes to hosts with Microsoft 365 or Office as these are the intended targets for Entra ID token theft. If the scoping step is too broad, focus on executive workstations or hosts with high integrity levels first.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is using Monday.com redirects and .vu landing pages to deliver Knight Office phishing lures to M365 users.

hunt.name: Knight Office Phishing Delivery and Redirects
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the early delivery and redirection stages of a Knight Office AiTM attack. It first scopes the environment to hosts with Microsoft 365 or Office software, then searches for direct connections to known phishing sender IPs and DNS lookups for the .vu top-level domains used by the kit. By correlating these network signals with legitimate Monday.com redirect infrastructure, we identify hosts that have likely interacted with the phishing lure before session theft occurs.

nodes.label: Scope to M365 and Office users

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%microsoft 365%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%office%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)
config.description: Identify hosts that have Microsoft 365 or Office software installed, as they are the primary targets for this campaign.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames. None means no hosts are reported with M365/Office installed.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, process_name, time FROM hb_network_connection WHERE instr(',' || '{{knight_ips}}' || ',', ',' || dst_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts communicating with known IPs used by the phishing sender or the operator console.
config.expected_signal: A connection from a browser or script to the identified IPs. Silence means no recorded interaction with the specific IOCs.

primitive_config.label: Direct connections to Knight infrastructure
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, process_name, time FROM hb_network_connection WHERE instr(',' || '{{knight_ips}}' || ',', ',' || dst_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.content: SELECT LOWER(query_hostname) AS domain, device_hostname, COUNT(*) AS lookups, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE ((LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%.vu' AND LOWER(query_hostname) NOT LIKE '%.vu.%') OR (instr(',' || '{{monday_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0)) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY domain, device_hostname
config.description: Find DNS requests for the .vu TLD used for landing pages or the Monday.com domains used for redirect chains.
config.expected_signal: A rare .vu domain resolution or a Monday.com resolution that precedes Knight infrastructure traffic.

config.objective: Determine if the observed network activity indicates a successful redirection from Monday.com to a Knight Office phishing site on a .vu domain or direct interaction with phishing sender IPs.
config.description: Synthesize the network and DNS evidence to determine if a host successfully navigated the redirect chain to a Knight Office landing page.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict citing connection timestamps and domain rarity.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of malicious | suspicious | benign per host, citing relevant rows from network and DNS sources.

config.question: The triage verdict identifies at least one host as malicious or highly suspicious for phishing interaction.
config.condition: The triage verdict identifies at least one host as malicious or highly suspicious for phishing interaction.
config.description: Direct the hunt based on the agent's findings. If data was unavailable for scoped hosts, refer to the analyst review for manual verification of missing telemetry.
Prevent the potential completion of the AiTM theft by isolating the host that interacted with the phishing lure.
config.instructions: Isolate the host from the network and initiate a password reset and M365 session revocation for the primary user.

config.description: Confirm the phishing interaction by searching email gateway logs for the Knight Office lure themes and resolving missing telemetry gaps.
config.instructions: Review email gateway logs for subjects containing 'Signature Required' or 'Approval Pending'. Look for character substitutions like 'lmportant'. Correlate identified email recipients with the hosts seen in this hunt. If the host was identified in the scoping step but yielded no network evidence, investigate potential gaps in telemetry coverage (e.g. agent health) for that specific asset.

config.description: Document findings and update IOCs for future monitoring.
config.instructions: Record any new .vu domains or redirector URLs found. If token theft is confirmed, transition to the identity-focused follow-on hunt.
